_note: Owner: Role Building. Shared contract. "fighters" and "commander" are what the game plays today: the 12 prototype fighters, unchanged. "launch_roster" is the 25-fighter DRAFT awaiting Doctor Def's approval; on approval it replaces "fighters". Who exists. Shared contract: written by Role Building, read by Character Dev (looks), Animations (clips per class) and Actions/Functions (the fight). Every fighter is a two-legged humanoid on the shared Mixamo rig; creature looks come through horns, tails and armor. Base stats are 1-star; armor and mr default to 25 when absent. 'source': prototype = live in prototype/raid.html, PROPOSED = drafted here for Doctor Def's approval. 'status' of the whole list is DRAFT until approved. Concept lines follow the locked style line (docs/STYLE_LINE.md): size belongs to class, tier shows only as amount of armor, creature parts stay smaller than the class signal, no wings, tails no longer than knee height, long ears only on Leaf in the Wind, hands empty (props are separate).

commander_full.name: Commander
commander_full.note: The player. No class at run start; can take one after a boss win. Casts magic attacks (magic.json), never equips items.

launch_roster.name: Brasshorn
launch_roster.concept: Ram-like brawler with short fur and two curled horns tight to the head, in a plain hide vest; charges first and asks later.

launch_roster.name: Mossling
launch_roster.concept: Gentle forest sprite with moss-tuft hair under a wide leaf cap, who patches friends with glowing spores.

launch_roster.name: Glintwick
launch_roster.concept: Candle-maker's apprentice whose wax-drip pointed hat glows at the tip, flinging sparks of raw magic.

launch_roster.name: Pebblejaw
launch_roster.concept: Gravel-skinned bailiff with a square jaw and a flat stone crown, who plants its feet and refuses to move.

launch_roster.name: Sparkfen
launch_roster.concept: Newt-like marsh keeper with a short tail, flicking wisp embers from the lantern on its back.

launch_roster.name: Duskpip
launch_roster.concept: Fox-faced scamp with short ears flat under its cowl, who waits in your blind spot and taps the weak point.

launch_roster.name: Seedskip
launch_roster.concept: Sprout-haired sprite with long leaf ears and a burr-studded cape, who hops behind foes and tangles their feet.

launch_roster.name: Driftwing
launch_roster.concept: Kite-runner with a stiff swept scarf, a fin crest and one steel bracer, who rides the breeze and drops gusts from above.

launch_roster.name: Hushfang
launch_roster.concept: Wolf-snouted duelist behind a cloth mask, one steel gauntlet, who never speaks and never misses a weak point.

launch_roster.name: Thistlestep
launch_roster.concept: Thistle-haired acrobat with long leaf ears and one bark shin guard, who vanishes in a puff of seeds and lands behind you.

launch_roster.name: Ironbloom
launch_roster.concept: Gardener-knight with petal-shaped steel shoulder guards over plain work clothes, who fights like a summer storm.

launch_roster.name: Inkwhistle
launch_roster.concept: Owl-faced scribe with a feather-tufted pointed hood and one collar plate, who writes glowing spell lines in the air.

launch_roster.name: Stonegavel
launch_roster.concept: Badger-striped court warden with one slab chest plate and a square crown, who slows anyone who argues.

launch_roster.name: Auric Stag
launch_roster.concept: Stag-faced sage with small golden antlers tucked under a wide hood brim and partial gilt plates; the antlers glow when an ally falls.

launch_roster.name: Cinder Marquis
launch_roster.concept: Dapper salamander noble in a smouldering velvet coat with a gilt pauldron and cuffs, lighting flame sprites like party candles.

launch_roster.name: Gale Sovereign
launch_roster.concept: Heron-crested ruler with a stiff storm-grey mantle and partial cloud-silver armor, who lifts whole lines into the air.

launch_roster.name: Basalt Magistrate
launch_roster.concept: Volcanic-rock judge in partial basalt-grey plates with glowing seams, whose verdict lands like a rockslide.

launch_roster.name: Thornroam Pilgrim
launch_roster.concept: Beetle-helmed traveller with long leaf ears, a waist-length thorn cape and bark greaves, who roots foes in rings of thorns.

launch_roster.name: Kilnbrand Vanguard
launch_roster.concept: Bear-like smith captain armored nearly head to toe, its ornate chest plate glowing like an open kiln; every blow rings like an anvil.

launch_roster.name: Starloom Seer
launch_roster.concept: Moth-faced seer in mostly armored star-blue plates with an ornate crescent-tipped pointed hat, who casts constellations as starfire.

launch_roster.name: Hearthflame Regent
launch_roster.concept: Short-tailed dragonkin regent, mostly armored, whose ornate back lantern keeps a ring of flame sprites alight.

launch_roster.name: Moonhollow Duelist
launch_roster.concept: Cat-eyed fencer armored almost head to toe, with an ornate crescent-moon cowl clasp, who strikes between two heartbeats.

launch_roster.name: Sabrecrown
launch_roster.concept: Grey-maned lion war chief in full armor with a pale silver circlet and a short tufted tail, who finds the gap in any armor and widens it.

launch_roster.name: Tidewell Abbess
launch_roster.concept: Coral-horned spring keeper in full shell armor under a wide shell-brim hood, with a teal sash, who draws strength from foes to mend friends.

launch_roster.name: Lodestorm
launch_roster.concept: Storm-caller in full iron armor with a swept fin mantle and steel-blue cuffs, who pulls foes off their feet and pins them in place.
